{{Quote|My name is Oteg. I serve the Jedi Order and lead the Republic's First Expeditionary Fleet.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Oteg]]|<ref name="TOR:TJP" />}}
The '''First Expeditionary Fleet''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] that consisted of over fifty vessels. The fleet's flagship was the [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] [[Telos (Valor-class)|''Telos'']], and it included six heavy cruisers and over two dozen corvettes. When it was not operating on a mission, it was usually stationed at [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="TOR:TJP" />
